# skycloak_extensions (Data Source)

Extension catalog available to the workspace. Use an extension's `id` in `skycloak_cluster_extension`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_extensions" "all" {}

output "marketplace_extensions" {
  value = [for e in data.skycloak_extensions.all.extensions : e.name if e.source == "marketplace"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Read-Only

- `extensions` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--extensions))

### Nested Schema for `extensions`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) What the extension does.
- `documentation_url` (String) Documentation URL.
- `id` (String) Extension ID.
- `keycloak_versions` (List of String) Supported Keycloak major versions.
- `name` (String) Extension name.
- `repository_url` (String) Source repository URL.
- `source` (String) Source (`marketplace`, `custom`).
